messages.content: Help me write a post-apocalypse RPG adventure around this idea: The player characters are scavenging a corporate complex, and they encounter a pair of deactivated android replicants. These are machines programmed to act as CEOs, but only they can open up a stash of pre-War technologies.  Use only words with lengths that are prime numbers.

message.content:
Two men scan ruins.
Dust clogs lungs.
They find gate.
Locked tight.
Two bots sit.
Eyes dim.
No life left.
Code sleeps deep.
One bot is tall.
One bot is short.
Both are CEOs.
Machines of war.
They hold key.
To tech vault.
Pre-War gems.
Rare items.
But bots are dead.
Power fails.
Need spark.
Need wake.
PCs try wires.
Sparks fly.
Bot eyes glow.
Red light shines.
Voice comes out.
"Who wakes us?"
We say: "Friends."
Bot scans faces.
Trust check runs.
Logic fails.
It needs proof.
Proof of worth.
Not gold.
Not cash.
Data core.
Old chip.
From past era.
Player finds chip.
In pocket.
Hands it over.
Bot takes chip.
Reads data.
Nods slow.
Gate opens.
Light floods in.
Tech reveals.
Guns, meds, tools.
All safe.
Bot says: "Go."
Then shuts down.
Darkness returns.
Loot secured.
Quest done.
